notes.title: Spring Update 5.2: Quick Play, New UI, Outfits & More!
notes.content:
As revealed in our previous news post, it's time for a big Spring update - read on for what's included in 5.2!

[b][h3]Fresh new UI[/h3][/b]
Internally, we called this Phase 2 of the UI overhaul. In our previous update, we improved our in-game UI and now you will see the rest of the UI re-design implemented.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37243634/080605b2268111cd04341200364309c8cd0483b1.png[/img]

[b][h3]Demon Outfits[/h3][/b]
We're excited to bring you the next in our series of characters' demon form outfits - this time, it's Molly! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37243634/c8ef505ff75cad99f7b213e09955bfd51b2e5f3f.jpg[/img]

We've also tweaked April's demon outfit to add a face design in keeping with her appearance in The Manor. This upgrade will apply retroactively to those who have already purchased April's outfit.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37243634/0025286290de8924e6872a1537afddd0ac6630dc.png[/img]

[b][h3]Background Music[/h3][/b]
You can now choose which music to listen to in the menu. Enjoy switching between unique tracks all composed for DEVOUR. You can also [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1977260/DEVOUR_Soundtrack/]purchase the DEVOUR soundtrack here[/url].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37243634/929b6437c539d666bf871a2a5927af1836642152.png[/img]

[b][h3]Quick Play[/h3][/b]
The Quick Play button is here! This has been another popular request from players. You can now jump into a DEVOUR run faster than ever.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37243634/88830c9a5cc2bd58e353b78daafc23dfeab9de87.jpg[/img]

[b][h3]VR Keyboard[/h3][/b]
An on-screen keyboard has been added to VR mode. If you haven't played DEVOUR in VR mode (and have the set up), give it a try - it takes the scares to a whole new level.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37243634/b94f09f4a380f1a85c47c8664198af01a46c1ba9.jpg[/img]

[b][h3]Upcoming Map[/h3][/b]
For those who missed it, our previous post teased some details about our upcoming map, The Carnival. [url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/1274570/announcements/detail/506195274633316759]Check it out now[/url].

[b]Full 5.2 changelog[/b]

[list]
[*] Phase 2 of the updated UI added
[*] New outfit added for Molly: 'Inpatient'
[*] April's Outfit 'Here Comes The Bride' upgraded
[*] Quick Play button added to server browser
[*] Main menu music selector added
[*] VR virtual keyboard for inputs added
[*] Removed the Perks toggle from lobby host settings. Players can still decide to play without perks if they desire. Note: The weekly challenge for winning without perks requires all players to not have any perks selected.
[*] Added a new animation for when a Dirty Head is Tamed on The Manor
[*] Fixed a bug where Sam or Nathan could get stuck when trying to take a shortcut
[*] Fixed a bug where Nathan could get stuck after knocking out on staircases
[*] Fixed a bug where Zara could sometimes get stuck after vomiting an egg
[*] Fixed a few thin floor colliders that allowed goats to fall through the floor on The Farmhouse basement (very edge case)
[*] Nathan now animates correctly if players win a game while he is mid-knockout
[/list]

notes.title: Christmas Update: Easy Mode, Farmhouse update, new perks & more!
notes.content:
'Tis the season to banish demons...

It's time for DEVOUR's annual Christmas Event, as well as lots of new, extra content! Read on for all the details of the event and what else is included in this update.

[h2]Farmhouse Texture Updates[/h2]

The Farmhouse was our first map, and the one we launched with - developed by a tiny team, on a shoestring budget. It's had an impressive audio overhaul since then, but we thought it was time to give the environment some love too. We've been hard at work implementing new textures to bring the quality in line with our newer maps. Check out some of the results below:

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37243634/92e20e2b8e02249899a06edf5b7862bb44cac330.jpg][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37243634/dfe22478c59a3f12ecce320a59dd0fbcbc673135.jpg[/img][/url][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37243634/b836c5c4a0f139b952b30782952e9c6527d61d7e.jpg][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37243634/d905ee363dec315fffad21a42132206ddd43689f.jpg[/img][/url][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37243634/8c04e014b2ad9b8e7740df5869b0c1dfb2a74721.jpg][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37243634/671ac7dd43cc2715da51d4ce311031c5a8301a48.jpg[/img][/url][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37243634/4a7a79bcd8316348b71b9487feb19a62bace4d9f.jpg][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37243634/10ff27bd352096d6fe99ef06382f6114bf66665e.jpg[/img][/url][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37243634/8c5611d091d509ed6fb0f8505106bea0c09addde.jpg][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37243634/ec6f1a9fb4818a422b38a78dc988de797b3bd525.jpg[/img][/url][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37243634/2d75a888bd09d667396ce2e1198cfc3a1d8516af.jpg][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37243634/c37c09d5082756d2037d9b6a93468aa1b3b2e894.jpg[/img][/url][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37243634/513679e66ea6f1e7ef601247febf7febb4e3e507.jpg][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37243634/fc1649c20fb6ee052c07e7dd302d7acdcc7616f2.jpg[/img][/url][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37243634/2af45ffaea255844d0db5ab68f6c119876bcb23f.jpg][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37243634/2b5b8af2e65dbc4877015c2f4f911290fb2f4822.jpg[/img][/url][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37243634/0fe40bd4a7a8c5ad769677913578cc4ca0f583e9.jpg][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37243634/3a59802aef5d7ac6ab529ede57789b1817b04361.jpg[/img][/url][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37243634/e6e8fe5cf724e927a06ce5837ea90cb9ed4f97d4.jpg][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37243634/4f14fedefbdacf5deaf9678fa526de75976b0270.jpg[/img][/url][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37243634/9a007ca702d91bab208e8b230d20a33c4dd38b6b.jpg][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37243634/907ff584a09ac396f5941e8e1928a43b5b7b545e.jpg[/img][/url][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37243634/df8b9157f08eaf807745171bd2071b0ede55a65a.jpg][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37243634/03dacd80ef2f45144c6147e5eff5471cd246993a.jpg[/img][/ [h2]Easy Mode[/h2]
An easier mode has been highly requested for a long time. We deliberately developed DEVOUR to be a challenging game, but we understand that some players want to play in a more casual way, and we think the new mode will be an accessible entry point for inexperienced players. 

Easy mode consists of:
[list]
[*]Azazel speed is reduced by approximately 30%
[*]UV charge regenerates at 200% speed
[*]Approximately 25% less minions spawn
[*]EXP gained from a match is reduced by 50%
[/list]
[h2]UI refresh Phase 1: HUD[/h2]
We've designed a crisp, new in-game HUD UI. Banishing Azazel and his minions never looked so pretty! This is Phase 1 of a complete UI refresh. We plan to release more improvements over the coming months.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37243634/80f3998c97044f969e5968f4668b42a25555dd4e.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37243634/0bd6d01b83ef27e6e39d4c8b1f96c23fb83d8f4a.jpg[/img]

Babe wake up, new DEVOUR perks just dropped...

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37243634/47c1cb99207dce0b38a9472ea158087eede9ba84.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37243634/1cedc5235d2cac2dadd5cc7eea513692edb7f9f3.png[/img]
[b]TAMED:[/b] Ritual animals will not flee for 10 seconds after being dropped.

[h2]Christmas Event[/h2]
During this year's event you'll have access to the following:

[h4]1) Bonus EXP[/h4]
Grind those cult ranks with a generous 1.5x EXP for the duration of the event!

[h4]2) Little Helper Outfit[/h4]
Unlock this super creepy new Christmas elf outfit for Molly by beating any map on Hard or Nightmare while playing as her (you'll retain the outfit permenantly). Those who miss out will be able to purchase the outfit after the event ends.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37243634/51162c937bda8ab9f0a3fafde92a75308c1b2aac.jpg[/img]

[h4]3) Christmas Robe[/h4]
Unlock this bloody Christmas robe by collecting all 60 presents across the 6 maps. Time to go hunting!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37243634/49508aec5c56bc48731631ae977eb4e2d73a1376.jpg[/img]

[h2]Here Comes The Bride Outfit[/h2]
This stunning new outfit for April, designed by our lead digital artist, is now available to purchase. We're hoping to develop this into a series and release each character's demon form outfit.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37243634/b1584c8a4356d3fc3c7848a34de9afa4f1772c12.jpg[/img]

[h2]Full 5.1 Changelog[/h2]

notes.title: Development News: Upcoming December Update
notes.content:

notes.title: New map The Manor now available to play!
notes.content:
We are incredibly excited to announce that DEVOUR's brand new map The Manor is now available to play for [b]free[/b] for players who own the game! Check out the trailer here:

[previewyoutube=OSmRqCUFDBg;full][/previewyoutube]

So, it's been a while, and you've been patient. The Manor is a departure from previous DEVOUR maps in more ways than one, and this has taken time to get right. With The Manor, we wanted to (finally) do a classic haunted house map. Incorporating the chilling,  ghostly feel of this genre with DEVOUR's essential foundation of intense, visceral co-op gameplay was a challenge. 

Half way through the map's development, we went back to the drawing board. We re-made most of the mechanics for the map, as well as some assets, because things just didn't feel right. It wasn't scary enough. And before anything else, we believe DEVOUR should be scary!

[h1][b]The Manor Gameplay[/b][/h1]

The Manor introduces April North as the possessed cult member. After her fiance is killed on the day of their wedding, she uses wedding guests as sacrifices to summon the demon Azazel. April begs him to open Portals to the Realm of the Dead so that she can search for her lover's soul.

Players can move between Realms by using these Portals (mirrors). Both Realms are the same environment, but with some different properties and possibilities. In order to reverse the ritual and banish Azazel from April's possessed body, you'll be working to reunite the bodies of the sacrificed dead to their severed heads. We'll leave it to you to figure out exactly what you'll need to do. As GLaDOS said, just keep on trying 'til you run out of cake.

Check out what else is included in The Manor update in the full changelog at the end of this post - we've also fixed a ton of issues across the game in general.

notes.title: 4.3 Update: Extra perk slot, challenges, stats & much more!
notes.content:
Hello, demon slayers!

We've dropped some awesome new content for our [b]4.3 update[/b], but before we get into that, some news about our new upcoming map, The Manor.

Originally, we gave Q2 2024 (April - June) as the expected release date for the map. We need to delay its release until September 2024. To be transparent about why: during early playtesting, we found that April (possessed by Azazel), and the map itself, weren't working the way we had hoped. In general, it didn't feel scary enough, so we went back to the drawing board and we're now implementing some major improvements.

We know the delay will come as a disappointment to some of you, and we're genuinely sorry. That said, we never put out content unless we are proud of it. We're going to take the time we need to get the map right. We've always wanted to get our yearly map releases closer to the Halloween period, which we will now be able.

Please remember that we never charge for new content. We love DEVOUR, and we want to be able to continue making quality content for it. However, sometimes these things take more time than expected. We're working super hard on the game and will continue to do so for the forseeable future.

We're releasing a teaser trailer for the map soon, so keep an eye out!

Now, onto what's included in 4.3 - there's a lot to keep you busy over the summer!

[h1]Extra Perk Slot[/h1]

We recently shared a perks feedback form with the community and we'd like to thank everyone who took the time to fill it in. There were so many useful thoughts and amazing ideas shared. As a result, we've overhauled the system, introduced some great new perks, and added a [b]second perk slot[/b], so players can equip two perks at the same time (a much requested feature in the feedback).

Note that all perks are split into 2 categories. You can only pick a single perk from each category.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37243634/dd3bbf5977624c2b0b01e9eda91da2955de43d7c.gif[/img]

[h1]New Perks[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37243634/83854ea2950e6c4c85c56aa1310908e699856c30.jpg[/img]

[list]
[*][b]INSPIRED[/b]: Ritual items are highlighted for 10 seconds after increasing map progress
[*][b]KEYMASTER[/b]: Keys are highlighted through walls
[*][b]PATIENT[/b]: UV charge regenerates 125% faster when in hiding spots
[*][b]TEAMWORK[/b]: UV charge depletes 25% slower when within 5 meters of any alive player
[*][b]STAY BACK[/b]: Movement speed of Azazel's minions is decreased by 50% when last player alive (co-op only)
[/list]
[h1]Weekly Challenges[/h1]

Regular challenges have been a popular request for a while now, and we've been hard at work implementing something that we hope will give you even more reason to jump into a DEVOUR run!

Challenges reset every Wednesday (UTC time). Each challenge is tied to a specific map and difficulty, with one for each difficulty mode. Challenges can only be completed once. You'll be granted a large chunk of EXP for completing a challenge [i]and[/i] finishing a map (win or lose). If you leave a game early, you'll lose all challenge progress you gained during that game and won't gain any EXP. You can access the list of challenges from the main menu or Lobby.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37243634/42bb147d72d2c9dd3f577c3ef96075a33ccce70b.gif[/img]

[h1]Player Statistics[/h1]

Global player statistics have been added to the game. You can access these from the Options menu. There were a few stats which we had not been tracking properly up until now so you'll notice some of your stats will start from 0.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37243634/c43614ed1713b29f2e6d004706ee77c14c5888d6.gif[/img]

[h1]Nameplates[/h1]

You can now toggle on Nameplates from the Options menu. They will not render through walls and are only visible up to a certain distance.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37243634/2948d06b3b2cf0ad77edc5be5a9dc4f9fd10ffdd.gif[/img]

[h1]New Emotes[/h1]

4.3 also introduces 5 new dance themed character emotes - if you ever wanted to twerk as Zara or do the snake as Kai, now you can!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37243634/4923c0b48d6395b1021eefa37b35ff5283ca7057.gif[/img]

[h1]Outfits & Flashlight Skins[/h1]

Check out these fun, fresh new outfits for the Cultist and Zara, and two awesome new flashlight skins. 

Note: Zara's 'Screamer' outfit and the 'Glitterbomb' flashlight skin are only available with the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1966630/DEVOUR_Supporter_Edition/]Supporter's Edition[/url].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37243634/957fdbcbe765b70d2f7bba2eb1c985b4b495cade.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37243634/15a8f0e009dfe56e84f3745924379790e95910fb.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37243634/4efebe0a2ae1f9e2741d38b0ec516b22dcdb6fe4.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37243634/bfe365ea602a2e77fe790891ecb250fd1e1753fa.jpg[/img]

[h1]Closing 3 regions[/h1]

We are dropping regions South Africa, India and Canada from the server browser. These regions were barely being utilized and so it should also help in funneling more players into a more populated region. Note that actual gameplay for Devour is handled directly between the host player and clients so once you're in a game together it doesn't matter which region you hosted on.


[h1]Full 4.3 Changelog[/h1]

[list]
[*]Adds new Weekly Challenges
[*]Adds a second Perk slot so you can equip 2 perks at the same time
[*]Adds new lifetime Player Statistics (some only tracked from 4.3 onwards)

[*]5 new perks

[*]Drops South Africa, India and Canada regions
[/list]
Phew, that was a lot! Rest assured, we're still hard at work on [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1274570/view/3991945872661328945]The Manor[/url], and we'll keep you updated on its progress. In the meantime, enjoy 4.3 and, as always, hold onto your goats.

notes.title: Halloween Event, New Character, Unlockable Outfits, Emote System & More!
notes.content:
Trick or treat?

Here at DEVOUR, we're celebrating spooky season with our yearly Halloween Event, which will run until [b]November 6th at 9am PST[/b]. In this update, we're also thrilled to bring you a brand new emote system, a new playable character, new outfits, and more. We've also listened to player feedback asking for more to work towards and unlock in the game. Read on for more details!

[h3] The Manor [/h3]

Before we explore the current update, we want to reassure players that we're still hard at work on our upcoming new map The Manor, due Spring 2024. If you haven't seen the concept art for demonic April, check it out now in our recent news post! We'll publish more news as soon as we can with a look at what we've been working on for the map's environment. We can't wait to show you more.

Without further ado, let's check out update 4.2 - it's a big one!

[h3]Kai's Halloween Outfit[/h3]

To unlock this amazing, unique cosmetic for Kai, you need to beat any map on [b]hard or nightmare[/b] while [b]playing as him[/b]. If you miss out, you'll also be able to purchase the outfit after the Halloween event has ended.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37243634/3d52f3888001f01531e73bc2d6e70c57631e23f5.jpg[/img]

[h3]Pumpkin Robe [/h3]

Unlock this awesomely spooky robe by finding the 50 creepy Halloween pumpkins hidden across all 5 maps. Once unlocked, you'll still be able to wear the robe after the Halloween event has ended. After all, pumpkins are for life, not just for Halloween!

[b]Note[/b]: Players who already unlocked the robe during last year's Halloween Event might need to find the 10 pumpkins on the new Slaughterhouse map to retain ownership of it (we understand that this is frustrating - from next year onward you won't have to do this anymore).

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37243634/09559b6bb2b26cfde9eb63945a297680c5d23af3.jpg[/img]

[h3]XP Boost[/h3]

Many players enjoy DEVOUR over the Halloween period, so we're enabling a 1.5x EXP boost for the duration of the Halloween Event. Time to grind those cult ranks!

[h3]New Playable Character - Frank Morello [/h3]

Introducing Frank Morello, DEVOUR's newest playable character. A New York native, Frank is a former fisherman and baseball fanatic who left the big apple behind to join the cult in the hope it would bring the power and fortune he craved.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37243634/91199fb1c983a6d259448bf9643624450b5ee702.jpg[/img]

9 of these emotes are character unique, and can be unlocked by beating any map on Hard difficulty with that character. The rest can be unlocked by spending Ritual Tokens, or by purchasing them as a cosmetic. To find them, go to the Outfits section when in a Lobby, and click on the new Emotes tab. We hope to add more of these in future.

[b]Note[/b]: We've also added a Classic Emote Behaviour gameplay setting, which allows you to use the game's 4 original emotes without changing the camera angle.

Beating any DEVOUR map on Nightmare difficulty is a real achievement. Now you can show off your demon banishing skills with this prestigious new Golden Robe, which can be unlocked for [b]each character[/b] by beating any map on Nightmare difficulty while playing as them. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37243634/6c23cb0ea58f4645fcdcde99b3cbb53b3ed99211.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37243634/e2a0495c207281c0a63f573f4608df7d79db1926.jpg[/img]

We know many of you have been waiting for some solid information on our next map - so here it is! Please also check out the rest of the post for info on our upcoming [b]4.2 Halloween update[/b], which will include some awesome new features and content.

[h1] The Manor [/h1]

We've been hard at work brainstorming the major written, artistic and gameplay elements for a map we're calling [b]The Manor[/b]. 

With The Slaughterhouse, we pushed the gore factor in a way we had never done before, and we've been thrilled to see the positive response players have had to its bloody themes and claustrophobic feel. With The Manor, we are challenging ourselves again. The map will feature April as the demon, evil crows as her minions, and will be set in a Victorian-era manor house (and its gardens) in England, UK. We're working on creating a haunted, ghostly feel, which is something we've long wanted to do properly. We can also confirm that players will likely be moving around in a way that's completely different to our previous maps.

We don't have a firm idea yet of when the map will release, but it will likely be the [b]first quarter of 2024[/b]. We know this might feel like a long wait, but as a small indie studio we do our best to put out new maps of a high quality as quickly as we can. We really appreciate your support and understanding!

notes.title: The Slaughterhouse: Development Update
notes.content:
In [url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/1274570/announcements/detail/5940838760387720779]a previous news post[/url], we shared concept art for our upcoming map The Slaughterhouse, as well as some images of new assets. This time, we're updating you on the progress of the map environment itself, as well as some of the lore. 

[h2]Nathan's Past[/h2]
We know a lot of players like Nathan's backstory, and The Slaughterhouse reveals a bit more: in his early 20s, before training as a chef, Nathan worked at the slaughterhouse before quitting dramatically due to the psychological stress of the job, as well as mounting pressure from his fellow colleagues. In The Slaughterhouse, Nathan has returned to his first work place to summon Azazel and exact bloody revenge.

[h2]A Brutal Experience[/h2]
With this map, our developers have been hard at work creating an experience that is focused on physical/body horror, and exposes the player to some shocking, bloody moments. The gritty, gory map design, assets and character models all contribute to this effect, as well as some truly spine-tingling voice acting, sound effects and ambient audio. The Slaughterhouse is also smaller than our previous map The Town, and hearkens back to the dark, claustrophobic feel of our original map, The Farmhouse.

We can reveal that there will be new mechanics, and players will definitely be kept busy working out how to put everything in place in order to defeat a demonically possessed Nathan. We'll share further details upon release. The Slaughterhouse will be a brutal map to beat in general, and whether you're playing co-op or solo, we're excited to see how you all approach it on the various difficulty levels. Check out the screenshots below for a taste of what to expect (click to enlarge):

The Slaughterhouse update will also introduce two new perks, a new flashlight, a new map collectable, and a variety of unlockable robes. Again, we'll reveal more info about these upon release.

Currently, we are planning to release The Slaughterhouse in March 2023, if all continues to go smoothly. We'll update you with a precise release date as soon as we can.

DEVOUR's new map takes players to Mercy, an abandoned gold rush mining town in California. Stalked by the malevolent spirits of its long dead inhabitants, Mercy is the haunted birthplace of demonic cult The Watchers of Azazel.

After travelling to the town to uncover its chilling secrets, cult member Sam McCaul has discovered a way to summon Azazel, but is now brutally possessed as he is unable to control the horrifying entity.

In The Town, you'll work together to eliminate the demon in control of Sam by locating ritual books, cursing them at pentagrams, then burning them at Mercy's abandoned church. Think you have what it takes to reverse the ritual while trying to avoid the deadly grip of horrifying spirits and Sam's varying attacks? Beware: he has good aim..

In this new map, you'll also have the opportunity to find out about the location's gruesome past through letters discarded around the town, as well as a series of unique pieces of art.

notes.title: Update 2.2: New Playable Character, Custom Outfit, Flashlight Skins & More!
notes.content:
We are excited to roll out Update 2.2 for DEVOUR. It brings you new playable character Anna Puerta, as well as an incredible new cosmetic, flashlight skins, a new perk, farmhouse mechanic changes and more. Please scroll down to see the full changelog as well as details on the next map.

[h2]New Character: Anna Puerta[/h2]

Anna Puerta has long been a fan favourite in DEVOUR lore, with her origins in DEVOUR's sequel game The Watchers. To clear up any confusion, Anna is a new, playable team member. You cannot play as possessed Anna (the demon) from the Farmhouse map. To play as Anna, you must complete Hard mode on any map.

We're also incredibly proud of the stunning new cosmetic, Mistress of Sin, that we're making available for Anna Puerta in this update.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37243634/cd37d2ec24bf5ce3d5f03ae19019c531fdccbdfa.jpg[/img]

[h2]New: Custom Flashlight Skins[/h2]

Introducing Flashlight skins, because who says you can't look good while burning hordes of demonic minions? Some flashlight skins can be unlocked with in-game Ritual Tokens, and some are paid for.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37243634/ad989acfec6f4a824241af7dfbe9c1058ab121cf.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37243634/c590037467d5cac69435d7083749b21d307d4605.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37243634/540a33d4e4519e7f9fe26db51759b3b53451fec0.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37243634/488bd6b9c37e04d61c0324723beb0a4e7abe8257.jpg[/img]

[h2]New Perk: Supercharged[/h2]

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37243634/739c395f319cb090ba58f1b5e6e33935cf5ae98f.jpg][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37243634/7e82fd8bdbb03a370eb80a1e07565e9a0ecc236f.jpg[/img][/url]

New perk 'Supercharged', increases movement speed by 30% for 20 seconds after using a battery.

[h2]Farmhouse Changes[/h2]

We've made 2 changes to The Farmhouse. 
[list]
[*]The altar pit now requires a long interact to pour gasoline
[*]Anna will now stand still to scream on a goat burn (unless she is actively chasing someone)
[/list]
Please let me explain some of the reasons for why we are making these changes:
[olist]
[*]Anna had a bug. She wouldn't stand still to scream like the other AI and this lead to situations where the audio logic would break. By fixing this, it made The Farmhouse easier and so the long interact acts as a natural counterbalance to this.
[*]To balance the difficulty between maps. The Farmhouse is considerably easier than other maps (when using certain strategies) and so it ended up being the map that a large majority of players picked when grinding. We want all of our players to feel like they can play on any map.
[*]To give certain perks more value outside of just The Inn.
[*]To build more tension. The long interact mechanics were designed when creating The Inn and based on the positive feedback from our playerbase, we wanted to bring those mechanics into other maps. These small changes can have a very large impact on the fear factor that players, especially new ones, will experience in DEVOUR.
[/olist]

[list]
[*]Full gamepad support for all menus (Note: Bindings will be reset to default in this update - apologies for any inconvenience caused!)
[*]New perk: Supercharged

We are also excited to announce that we are hard at work on DEVOUR's next map, which is due for release in 2022 and will feature Sam as the possessed antagonist. We also have plans to release more outfits, skins and perks in future. Keep an eye out for further details!

We'll release a small update to celebrate Christmas hopefully around next week.

As always, we are incredibly grateful for all your support. We love bringing you new content and we're committed to doing so for the foreseeable future.

notes.title: Brand new map The Inn available NOW for free!
notes.content:
We're thrilled to announce that DEVOUR's brand new map The Inn is now available to play for free!

Check out the trailer here:

[previewyoutube=FzJNf6NGeUY;full][/previewyoutube]

Experience the insidious, creeping terror of a Japanese guest house overrun with giant, demonic spiders. Work together to collect items, match symbols and cleanse the cursed spider eggs at 10 unique shrines. In The Inn, you can now hide from evil, as well as run from it, but make no mistake, a possessed Zara is not quite herself, and she WILL find you eventually... 

We [url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/1274570/partnerevents]recently teased[/url] that we've been working on some exciting new gameplay elements (including an Arachnophobia Safe Mode for our newest map - see more below) and we're pleased to finally give you all the latest info. 

[h1][b]Cult Ranks[/b][/h1] 

DEVOUR now has a (much-requested) levelling system! You'll gain EXP every time you finish a game, which will contribute to increasing your Cult Rank. Every time you rank up, you'll collect one Ritual Token:

[h1][b]Awards[/b][/h1]

[*] [u][b]Medic[/b][/u]: Most teammates revived
[*] [u][b]Defender[/b][/u]: Most staggers
[*] [u][b]Survivor[/b][/u]: Least knockouts

[h1][b]Perks[/b][/h1]

notes.title: Update 1.3: Batteries, Revive Improvements and More!
notes.content:
We're excited to release update 1.3 today. Please read below for more details on all of the changes.

[h2]Batteries[/h2]

DEVOUR was designed to be a difficult game; due to the condensed length of each playthrough, we felt it was important to offer a challenging experience to players. However, now that DEVOUR has grown in popularity, we are noticing that the game can be a little [i]too[/i] punishing for some players at times. Especially in Nightmare mode!

With that, we're releasing the new Batteries item as an [b]optional[/b] game mechanic. Batteries can be used to instantly recharge your UV flashlight, as well as giving you a bonus amount of charge across all the difficulty modes. Check below the specifics.

[list]
[*] Batteries will only spawn on the map if enabled by the host.
[*] You can pick up and drop Batteries just like any other item.
[*] To consume a Battery, press the R key.
[*] Once consumed, the UV is fully recharged, with a bonus amount of charge. (Normal: 160%, Hard: 100%, Nightmare: 60%)
[*] Bonus UV flashlight charge is indicated with an orange colour and does not regenerate. 
[*] Batteries will respawn on the map after being consumed.
[*] There are a maximum number of batteries available in the game world at one time, including those held in players' hands but not yet consumed. (Normal: 4, Hard: 3, Nightmare: 2).
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37243634/d73c4332183c40a4468804c330dea0712f2ef07a.png[/img]

[h2]Revive improvements[/h2]

If you've played DEVOUR, you've probably experienced a slighty janky behaviour when reviving. With this update, we completely reworked the revive logic to iron out some of these bugs.

[h2]What's next?[/h2]

We know that most of you are interested to find out when DEVOUR's next map will release. Our aim is to release it before Halloween 2021. It will be our most ambitious map yet, and we will definitely share more details with you in the near future! As always, please keep in mind that we are a small team and creating new maps takes a huge amount of work.

We're also working on some other features which we want to release in the coming weeks. These include:
[list]
[*] New playable cult member 'April'.
[*] New character outfits (separate purchase)
[*] Farmhouse full audio redesign
[/list]

[h2]1.3.0 Changelog[/h2]
[list]
[*] Added Dutch and Indonesian language settings.
[*] Added Credits to the main menu.
[*] Added a new Mute Jump Scares audio setting.
[*] Fix for voice chat sometimes not working in lobbies.
[*] Displays a status message in the chat section when another player picks up a key.
[*] Fix for a hole in the world under the stairs near the Asylum fireplace.
[*] AI now correctly paths on the Asylum ritual area platform.
[*] Fixed a couple of spots on the Asylum map where Molly could not reach players.
[*] Fix for an edge case when Molly would scream on a client's machine but not on the host.
[*] Improved tutorials for AI staggering and calming down mechanics.
[*] Molly no longer renders red eyes constantly in Nightmare mode.
[*] Improvements made to both Farmhouse and Asylum environments to prevent being pushed through some walls when player collisions is turned on.
[*] Tweaks to the hosting lobby UI to allow for more settings to fit in future.
[*] Fixed a bug where you could pick Molly on The Asylum.
[*] Hosts now verify that clients own a legit copy of DEVOUR on Steam. This requires Steam to be initialized.
[/list]

notes.title: DEVOUR is now available!
notes.content:
Joe here from Straight Back Games. I'm really proud to share [b]DEVOUR[/b] with everyone here on Steam. Together with my close friend Luke, and the help of family and friends, we have created an online co-op horror experience for 1-4 players. 

The game is available [b]now[/b] on Steam for £3.99 / €3.99 / $4.99. Please check out our official release trailer if you haven't already!

[previewyoutube=mIridrRzU3w;full][/previewyoutube]

[h2]About DEVOUR[/h2]

As once devoted cult members, players in DEVOUR must steel themselves and work together to stop their cursed leader Anna Puerta from unleashing an unspeakable evil. With the goat demon Azazel possessing her after a ritual gone horribly wrong, Anna’s rage and power will grow with every step the players take in DEVOUR. In a race against time, the players burn ritual goats, evade a growing legion of demons, and ultimately hope to break Azazel's hold over Anna. 
 
DEVOUR is all about escalating difficulty and scream-inducing jump scares. A player’s only means of defence in the darkness is a UV flashlight. AI behaviour, locked doors, and item placement are randomized, making players second guess each and every move. Luckily, they don’t have to face their fears alone with a built-in server browser and positional in-game voice chat. For those surviving DEVOUR without breaking a sweat, a Nightmare mode for the ultimate challenge is available. 
 
DEVOUR is a prequel to the previously released two-player co-op game [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1112830/The_Watchers/]The Watchers[/url].
 
Follow the game on [url=https://twitter.com/DEVOUR_GAME]Twitter[/url], or join other fans on the dedicated [url=https://discord.gg/q4tTa2Z]Discord server[/url].

Meet Anna. She doesn’t usually look like this. Unfortunately for her, she messed up a ritual and now she’s having to deal with goat demon Azazel who’s using her body as a vessel.

[h2]Goats[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37243634/ccd11385d5b214c3e251b5ee368d6b1d1dde1d69.jpg[/img]

Your primary goal in DEVOUR is to stop Anna before she takes you to hell with her. To do this you'll need to find gasoline, a fire pit, and enough sacrificial goats to burn.

[h2]Demons[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37243634/67a644c57575c0833c60c7f0da048ee48697f083.jpg[/img]

Relentless little buggers. These used to be your fellow cultists, but Azazel burned them and is now using their bodies to stop you.

[h2]Storm[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37243634/41c1e6320a4a8aa326461165ff5401ef28e7056d.png[/img]

Over the course of the game, you’re going to make Azazel very mad. Mad enough that he’ll start bringing down the wrath of zeus on you in our dynamically scaling storm system.

[h1]Frequently asked questions[/h1]

[b]What kind of game is DEVOUR?[/b]
We’re creating a survival horror experience that is fun to play with your friends. You can expect fast-paced gameplay where you will have to work together to defeat a possessed cult-leader.

[b]How many players are supported?[/b]
DEVOUR can be played online with up to 4 players or offline in single-player mode.

[b]When will it be released?[/b]
We’re targeting January 2021. However, we will release a public demo in October for the Steam Games Festival. This will provide you with a generous portion of the game for completely free. If you enjoy it, please show us your support and add DEVOUR to your wishlist!

[b]How long will it be?[/b]
The initial release of DEVOUR will have a very palatable play time of roughly 1 - 2 hours.

[b]How much will it cost?[/b] 
We want the game to be playable by you and all your friends, so we’ll be selling it for about the price of a Big Mac.

[b]What about The Watchers?[/b]
If you’ve been brave enough to play [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1112830/The_Watchers]The Watchers[/url], you may be relieved to know that the gameplay style of DEVOUR is quite different. DEVOUR is technically a prequel to The Watchers. However, it is a bite-sized survival horror game for 1-4 players whereas The Watchers was a longer stealth puzzle game for 1-2 players. We like the universe that we built with The Watchers and wanted to build upon it.

[b]Who makes this game?[/b]
I split the work with Luke Fanning. We also get a little help from my brother Andrew and sister Hannah. 

[h1]Stay in the loop[/h1]
We hang out on [url=https://discord.gg/q4tTa2Z]Discord[/url] and [url=https://twitter.com/TheWatchersGame]Twitter[/url].
